system.description:
Thinking Outside the Box. After failing a non-Smarts Check outside Combat, you may re-roll every die showing a Smarts symbol.

Calculating (Flaw). Lose a Heart die when trying to read someone's emotional state or tell whether they are telling the truth.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.85
